title: Verify Alien Word Ordering
description: The string `order` lists the characters of an alien alphabet from smallest to largest. Return true if `words` is sorted lexicographically according to that alphabet. A word that is a prefix of another must come first.
constraints: order is a permutation of lowercase English letters
hints: Represent prerequisites as directed edges and process zero in-degree vertices.
A cycle prevents a complete ordering; unique orderings require a single available choice at each step.
